title: Slope as Rise over Run

serves.summary: Slope as rise over run: the learner counts the rise and the run between two points on a coordinate grid and drags the points to build a line with a given slope (positive, whole-number, fractional and negative). Practises finding, calculating and constructing slope.

request.objective: Make a line through two points with a given slope, and see slope as rise over run (8.EE.B.5)

problems.ask: Move the pins so the line has a slope of 3/4.
problems.goal: The two pins are at different grid points and rise / run equals 3/4.

problems.ask: Move the pins so the line has a slope of 2.
problems.goal: The two pins are at different grid points and rise / run equals 2.

problems.ask: Make a line with a slope of 1/2. The canvas no longer shows the slope: use the rise and the run.
problems.goal: The two pins are at different grid points and rise / run equals 1/2.

problems.ask: Make a line with a slope of -2/3.
problems.goal: The two pins are at different grid points and rise / run equals -2/3.
